title: app.setBadgeCount leaves the macOS dock badge empty for every positive count
body_source: independently authored constructed opening; fictional scenario
body:
### Electron Version

42.2.0

### What operating system(s) are you using?

macOS

### Operating System Version

macOS 14.7

### Expected Behavior

The dock badge displays the requested number.

### Actual Behavior

setBadgeCount returns false and no badge appears, even while the app is focused. I tried each variant separately:

```js
app.setBadgeCount(1);
app.setBadgeCount(8);
app.setBadgeCount(25);
```
